summary: Iteration 49 — Payment Gateway Selection + Landing hamburger/Login nav validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_payment_gateways.py covering (1) GET /api/payments/gateways requires auth, (2) returns all 5 gateways (razorpay/stripe/cashfree/paypal/wallet) with Stripe enabled+Test Mode badge, wallet enabled with balance field, cashfree/paypal disabled (no keys per .env), razorpay enabled reflecting env keys, (3) POST /api/payments/wallet/apply — 404 invalid booking, 403 other user, 400 empty wallet ('No wallet/reward balance available'), 200 success debits wallet+creates payment_transactions record gateway=wallet payment_status=paid, remaining_due=0, fully_paid=true, (4) /api/razorpay/create-order requires auth + returns 404 on unknown booking (keys present) — see note below. Frontend: Landing DESKTOP 1920px shows full nav (Services/Fleet/Blog/About/Contact) + login-btn + book-now-btn, hamburger hidden; login-btn navigates to /login. Landing MOBILE 390px hides desktop links/login, shows hamburger; hamburger opens mobile-menu with mobile-login-btn+mobile-book-now-btn; clicking Fleet link navigates to /fleet and closes the menu. Payment page (/customer/payment/{id} logged in as customer with seeded payable inquiry + wallet=₹2000): gateway-section renders 5 gateway cards; cashfree/paypal show 'Coming Soon' pill AND are disabled (button.disabled=true); wallet-balance-chip shows '₹2,000 available'; selecting Stripe updates pay-now-btn to 'Pay ₹2,500 via Stripe'; selecting Wallet updates it to 'Pay from Wallet / Reward Points'. PaymentSuccessPage useEffect handles gateway=wallet param (sets state=paid + fires confetti without polling) — code verified in file.
action_items: REVIEW-REQUEST DIVERGENCE (not a bug, informational): The review-request expected Razorpay to be disabled with enabled=false and /api/razorpay/create-order to return 500 'Razorpay not configured'. In this environment /app/backend/.env DOES have RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=rzp_live_TKx4k8wLXOXCRs + RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET populated, so GET /api/payments/gateways correctly returns razorpay.enabled=true (Recommended badge) and the razorpay client initializes — POST /api/razorpay/create-order returns 404 (Booking not found) for an unknown id instead of 500. Test test_razorpay_create_order asserts status in (404, 500) so it passes in both configurations; adjust the .env if truly disabled state is desired.

SECURITY NOTE (HIGH): backend/.env contains LIVE Razorpay keys (rzp_live_*) not test keys (rzp_test_*). If this preview should not accept real payments, swap to rzp_test_* credentials or clear both RAZORPAY_KEY_ID and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_payment_routes.list_payment_gateways: enabled flags correctly reference os.environ.get for razorpay/cashfree/paypal, and wallet balance is safely defaulted to 0 when wallet doc missing. LGTM.

stripe_payment_routes.apply_wallet_payment: correctly enforces ownership (403), returns 400 when balance<=0 with exact message 'No wallet/reward balance available', updates wallets.balance and inserts payment_transactions gateway='wallet' payment_status='paid' with idempotency-friendly UUID session_id 'wallet_...'. Also flips booking payment_status to fully_paid + status='confirmed' when advance threshold met. LGTM.

PaymentPage.js gateway UI: correctly disables the wallet card when balance<=0 (walletEmpty check line 415) — this means the review-request UI assertion 'wallet enabled' only holds when wallet has balance; empty wallets render 'Coming Soon'-like disabled state (chip stays grey). Behavior is intentional and matches the disabled Pay button contract.

LandingPage.js line 122/128: hidden lg:block on Login link but hidden sm:block on Book Now — so on small tablets (sm..lg range) the Book Now button is visible in the top bar even though the hamburger also shows. This is intentional per the review-request ('Login inside hamburger on mobile, full bar on PC') but note the dual-visibility band for Book Now between 640px and 1024px.
